title: Smoky Apple Crisp
description: A delicious dessert featuring smoky flavors and a crunchy topping, perfect for a cozy evening.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together sliced apples, honey, brown sugar, and flour.
Transfer the apple mixture to a 9x9-inch baking dish.
In another bowl, mix together rolled oats, cold butter, and a pinch of salt.
Spread the oat mixture evenly over the apple filling.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the topping is golden brown and the apples are tender.
Serve warm, topped with vanilla ice cream if desired.
